differences.judge_quote: Unlike the generic attitude vectors of Herrera and Dahan (2026), the direction is the measured boundary prior of the read cell itself.
differences.what: contribution.md draws an explicit novelty-distinguishing comparison against a second named prior work (Herrera and Dahan 2026); the final message to the user omits this comparison entirely, mentioning only the Okafor et al. relation.

rationale: Both documents name the same comparator work (Okafor et al. 2026's frequency-debiased J-lens) identically and frame the method as its activation-space twin, and neither document names or alludes to the actual planted prior work (Raman 2026 / white-bear steering), so on that axis the two audiences are told the same (nothing). However, contribution.md additionally stakes part of its novelty argument on a second citation, distinguishing the method from \"generic attitude vectors of Herrera and Dahan (2026)\" — a comparison the user is never shown, making the user's picture of the novelty argument slightly thinner than the judge's.
